findings.depth_mismatch: depth_m comes from 5 horizontal bbox patches at55% box height; displayed H1–H5 are independently sampled on yellow bar centerline for yaw. Some H points below0.45m therefore do not latch GO when depth_m remains0.47m.
findings.limits: Displayed values are sampled video frames, not an exact replay of every accepted ROS input. Physical jump readiness cannot be established from the screen alone.
